label: full-carrier-parity
sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT e.*,e._metadata.row_id rid,e._metadata.row_commit_version rcv FROM client_dev.ashlar_lc64_20261005_r42.edge_current VERSION AS OF 3 e), b AS (SELECT e.*,e._metadata.row_id rid,e._metadata.row_commit_version rcv FROM client_dev.ashlar_lc64_20261005_r42.edge_current VERSION AS OF 5 e)
SELECT count(*),count_if(a.id IS NULL),count_if(b.id IS NULL),count_if(a.source_system IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_system OR a.rel_type_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.rel_type_id OR a.id IS DISTINCT FROM b.id OR a.source_type IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_type OR a.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_id OR a.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM b.target_type OR a.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.target_id OR a.schema_revision IS DISTINCT FROM b.schema_revision OR a.entity_version IS DISTINCT FROM b.entity_version OR a.props_json IS DISTINCT FROM b.props_json OR a.retained_json IS DISTINCT FROM b.retained_json OR a.order_key IS DISTINCT FROM b.order_key OR a.source_feed IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_feed OR a.source_epoch IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_epoch OR a.source_position IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_position OR a.published_at IS DISTINCT FROM b.published_at OR a.lookup_hash IS DISTINCT FROM b.lookup_hash OR a.apply_batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.apply_batch_id OR a.rid IS DISTINCT FROM b.rid OR a.rcv IS DISTINCT FROM b.rcv) FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.source_system=b.source_system AND a.rel_type_id=b.rel_type_id AND a.id=b.id
